description: Domain terminological ontology for BDD scenario validation and semantic grounding.

terms.name: ShoppingCart
terms.description: Represents a customer's shopping cart containing line items and an optional applied promo code.

terms.name: PromoCode
terms.description: A marketing token that grants a discount when applied to a valid cart prior to its expiration.

terms.name: Expired
terms.description: A temporal state condition indicating that current timestamp exceeds expiration date.

terms.name: Discount
terms.description: The percentage or monetary reduction value associated with an active promo code.

terms.name: UAH
terms.description: Ukrainian Hryvnia currency unit for monetary values.

terms.name: Policy
terms.description: Business rules governing cart operations and discount applications.
